Libraries
```{r}

#for mefisto
library(reticulate)
reticulate::use_condaenv("mofa2_env", required = TRUE)
reticulate::py_config()
reticulate::py_module_available("mofapy2")


library(ggplot2)
library(svdx)
library(svdxBenchmark)

library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(Biobase)

```

Load
```{r load-raw}

mouse <- read.csv( file="./GSE153941_ab1_count_matrix.txt", header=T, sep=" ")
mouse <- as.matrix( mouse )
mouse_renca <- read.csv( file="./GSE153941_renca_count_matrix.txt", header=T, sep=" ")
mouse_renca <- as.matrix( mouse_renca )
all(rownames(mouse) == rownames(mouse_renca))
mouse <- cbind( mouse, mouse_renca )

snames <- colnames(mouse)
sid <- sapply( strsplit( snames, "_" ) , function(x) x[[1]][1])
meta_ab <- read.csv( file= paste0(raw_dataset_dir, "/ab1_metadata.csv"),
                     header=T ) %>% 
  mutate( Timepoint = str_sub( Timepoint, 2,2 ) ) %>% 
  mutate( Timepoint = as.numeric(Timepoint), 
          Group = factor( Group, levels =c("RS", "NR") ) #responder, non responder
          )

meta_renca <- read.csv( file= paste0(raw_dataset_dir, "/renca_metadata.csv"),
                     header=T ) %>% 
  mutate( Timepoint = str_sub( Timepoint, 2,2 ) ) %>% 
  mutate( Timepoint = as.numeric(Timepoint), 
          Group = factor( Group, levels =c("RS", "NR") ) #responder, non responder
          )
all( colnames(meta_ab) == colnames(meta_renca) )
meta <- rbind( meta_ab, meta_renca )
meta <- meta[ match( sapply( strsplit( colnames(mouse),  "_"), function(x) x[[1]] ), meta$AGRF_ID ), ]
rownames( meta ) <- colnames(mouse)
meta$Tissue <- factor( meta$Tissue, levels=c("AB1", "Renca") )

fd <- data.frame( id = rownames(mouse), symbol = rownames(mouse) )
rownames(fd) <- rownames(mouse)

es <- ExpressionSet( assayData = mouse, 
                     phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame( meta ), 
                     featureData = AnnotatedDataFrame( fd )
                     )

fdata <- fData(es)
Y_raw <- exprs(es)
xdata <- pData(es) %>% mutate( TissueGroup = paste(Tissue, Group) ) 

zdata <- xdata
```

# Define SVDX formulas
```{r formulas}
xformula = ~Group + Group:Timepoint 
zformula = ~Tissue 
```

# Optional inputs
```{r optional-inputs}
row_offsets <- rep(0, nrow(es))
col_offsets <- rep(0, ncol(es))
tj <- colSums( exprs(es) ); tj <- tj/exp(mean(log(tj)))

```

# Preprocess

```{r preprocess}
fdata <- as_svdx_fdata(
  fdata,
  feature_col = "id", #these are the rownames in the circ data
  label_col = "symbol", #these are what we will use for labeling features in plots
  enrichment_col = "symbol" #these are what we will use for enrichment when we do inferecne
)

prepared <- svdx:::prepare_svdx_data(
  Y = Y_raw,
  xdata = xdata,
  zdata = zdata,
  xformula = xformula,
  zformula = zformula,
  fdata = fdata,
  family = NULL, 
  log1p_transform = TRUE,              #already transformed      
  t_j = tj,
  normalize = TRUE,                    #data has already been normalization
  top_ftrs = 5000,
  center_rows = TRUE,    
  scale_rows = TRUE,
  allow_sparse_densification = TRUE,
  col_offset = col_offsets,
  row_offset = row_offsets,
  dataset_name = "bilateral"
)
```


#benchmark

```{r}
METHODS <- c(
  "svdx",
  "pca",
  "mefisto_duplicate_view",
  "nmf",
  "mixomics_pls",
  "spca",
  "sparse_nmf"
)
SPCA_KEEPX_GRID <- round(c(0.01, 0.25, 0.5) * nrow(prepared$Y))
SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID <- 10^c(-3, -2, -1)

rw_single <- run_real_world_single_benchmark(
  
  Y = prepared$Y,
  data = prepared$xdata,
  xformula = prepared$xformula,
  zdata = prepared$zdata,
  zformula = prepared$zformula,
  fdata = fdata, 
  
  K = 15, 

  methods = METHODS, 
  spca_keepX_grid = SPCA_KEEPX_GRID,
  sparse_nmf_lambda_grid = SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID,
  mefisto_covariates = "Timepoint",
  inference_methods = c("svdx"), 
  
  ftol_abs = 1e-5, 

    run_factorization = TRUE,
  run_inference = TRUE,
  
  inference_scope = "all",
  feature_sets = NULL,
  enrichment_backend = "internal",
  msigdb_db_species = "MM", 
  msigdb_species = "Mus musculus", 
  msigdb_collection = "M5", 
  msigdb_subcollection = "BP"
)

rw <- runSingleBenchmarkReports(rw_single = rw_single, 
                                    outdir = "./bilateral", overwrite=T, 
                                 color="Group", group="Group", line_group = "Group",
                                xaxis="Timepoint", 
                                 loading_enrichment = T, 
                                    enrichment_top_n = 25, 
                                svdx_report_args = list( z_adjustment = "fitted", 
                                                         heatmap_order_by = c("Tissue", "Group", "Timepoint"), 
                                                         feature_profile_show_se = T , 
                                                         feature_profile_color = "Group", 
                                                         feature_profile_facet = "Tissue", 
                                                         feature_profiles_top_n = 1L,
                                                         x ="Timepoint"
                                                         )
                                 )


```

  ),

  compile = FALSE,

)
